meta.title: SCRIPE-Frontend Auth, Recovery & Post-Login Policy MVVM Architecture

views.label: 1. CSP, Proxy & RouteGuard Walls
views.note: Strict CSP + WebAuthn headers, scr_auth_state proxy hint, and ordered walls (PendingPayment -> mcp -> mfa_enroll -> PBAC).

views.label: 2. 5-Layer MVVM & In-Memory Tokens
views.note: Shared Auth MVVM (View -> ViewModel -> Repository -> Service -> api-factory) with memory-only access JWTs.

views.label: 3. Fragment Scrub & Policy Recovery
views.note: URL #token= fragment extraction + history.replaceState scrub, dynamic GET /password-policy, and 204 no-auto-login reset.

components.label: Next.js Security Headers
components.explanation: Removes ignoreBuildErrors: true and sets X-Frame-Options: DENY, nosniff, WebAuthn Permissions-Policy, and API/WS Content-Security-Policy.

components.label: Edge Auth Proxy
components.explanation: Evaluates APP_ROUTE_MANIFEST public/devOnly flags, checks scr_auth_state hint cookie, and validates redirect params via isSafeRedirectTarget.

components.label: RouteGuard Gatekeeper
components.explanation: Exempts public recovery/callback routes and enforces PendingPayment -> MustChangePassword -> RequireMfaEnrollment (MFA_ENROLL_ALLOWED_ROUTES) -> PBAC.

components.label: Signin & Setup Views
components.explanation: Thin React Views keeping business logic in ViewModels while magicLinkUrl extracts #token= fragments and strips them via replaceState.

components.label: Password Recovery UI
components.explanation: Renders @core/ui PasswordWithPolicyField backed by live GET /password-policy rules without inventing hardcoded client complexity.

components.label: Account Security Console
components.explanation: Receives mfa_enroll=true redirects (/account/security?setupMfa=1) and fail-closed refreshes tokens upon 2FA/Passkey confirmation.

components.label: Auth & Login ViewModels
components.explanation: Propagates requireMfaEnrollment across Password, 2FA, QR, SSO, Phone OTP, Workspace Selector, and Signup flows via useServices().

components.label: Recovery & Policy Hooks
components.explanation: Coordinates ResetGrantToken recovery state, cooldowns, and dynamic tenant password policy hooks strictly under 300 lines.

components.label: Auth Repositories
components.explanation: Maps Verify2FAResponseModel, AuthModel, and SignupResponseDto cleanly through explicit Mappers returning Result<T>.

components.label: Auth Services
components.explanation: Dispatches typed /api/v1/auth/admin/* and /api/v1/auth/user/* calls via IApiService.

components.label: Memory Token & AppStore
components.explanation: Holds access JWTs strictly in SecureTokenService static memory while useAppStore partializes out secrets and defaultRedirectPath.

components.label: Per-Module ApiService
components.explanation: Broadcasts activeRefreshHandler, activeLogoutHandler, and tenant context across all module ApiService instances.

components.label: .NET 10 Auth API
components.explanation: Click through to inspect the .NET 10 SessionIssuerService, Lockout, ResetGrantToken, and Revocation Lifecycle.
